inventoryNotes: Fail-closed starter inventory only. Confirm every manual-copy target before setting inventoryComplete to true.
Citrix server names are not yet documented in this repository and must be added to requiredServers and targets.

PROD entries below are derived from the 4.7 Deployment Instructions runbook (rollout section), which supplies target directories, scheduled-task and service names, and log directories. It does NOT supply baseline manifest paths, config-contract paths, backup roots, or release tags, so those stay CONFIRM/TBD and every PROD entry stays needs-confirmation.

inventoryStatus is left at needs-confirmation deliberately: only 'confirmed' entries count toward required-server coverage, so adding these documents the runbook without letting the inventory claim a coverage it does not have.

VESEMSEGRESS02 and VESEMSEGRESS03 each run TWO processors (XML and DBQ) as separate instances of one executable out of a SINGLE directory, distinguished only by the RTP/RTPDP mode argument. Each is one deployment unit with two scheduled tasks; the two entries per server share a releaseRoot on purpose.
VESEMSEGRESS01 and VESEMSEGRESS03 use the SAME releaseRoot path on different boxes. Per-server wrappers assert their own hostname; do not collapse these entries.
VESEMSEGRESS01 is the only unit whose 4.7 step replaces the exe.config ('delete all files INCLUDING the exe.config file'); every other unit preserves the server's own config.
Excluded per brief Scope: cloud services (gateway services, MERA - VESMERA01, VESOMSVEMS01/02) already have standard deployment processes; joining them to the Git release discipline is later work.

Excluded per brief Scope: database objects (stored procedures, triggers, views) are a planned fast follow, outside the two-week window. The 4.7 runbook runs five SQL scripts on VESEMSINGRESS02 before its file copy; that step is not covered by these targets.
Starter OutboundDBQ paths match SERVERS.md UAT and processors/Deploy-OutboundDBQ-uat.ps1; PROD uses VESEMSEGRESS02/03 with different roots - confirm before inventoryComplete.

targets.note: UAT starter aligned with Deploy-OutboundDBQ-uat.ps1 / SERVERS.md. DBQ also deploys on VESEMSEGRESS02/03 in PROD - create one confirmed entry per deployed copy.

4.7 rollout: Windows SERVICE VES.RealtimeInboundEventService (the only service-shaped unit in 4.7), not a scheduled task. Logs C:\VLER\Logs\VES.InboundProcessor. Config preserved (runbook: except the exe.config files). Config leaf name is assumed from the service name - confirm.

4.7 rollout: scheduled task 'VLER EM Inbound _ Request _ Handler' (spaces around the underscores are literal). Logs C:\VLER\Logs\VES.InboundProcessor. Config preserved. Five SQL rollout scripts run before the file copy and are OUT OF SCOPE here. The release zip nests a folder - flatten it when staging. Config leaf name is assumed - confirm.

4.7 rollout: task VLER_EM_Real_Time_Outbound_Processor, mode RTP, logs E:\VLER\Logs\VES.OutboundProcessor. The ONLY unit that REPLACES its config (runbook: including the exe.config file, plus a pre-edited replacement) - stage release and config as one tree so the gate approves what actually lands. The runbook heads this section 'Vesemsingress01'; it is VESEMSEGRESS01.

4.7 rollout: task VLER_EM_Real_Time_Acknowledgement_Processor, mode RTP, logs E:\VLER\Logs\VES.OutboundProcessor. Runbook notes only one instance should be running from this tree. Config preserved. Separate tree from this server's XML+DBQ unit.

4.7 rollout: XML and DBQ share this ONE tree as two instances (RTP and RTPDP) with two tasks, VLER_EM_Real_Time_DBQ_Processor and VLER_EM_Real_Time_Outbound_Processor. Logs E:\VLER_OUTBOUND_AND_DBQ\Logs\VES.OutboundProcessor, shared by both, so log freshness is not per-processor evidence. Config preserved.

4.7 rollout: XML and DBQ share this ONE tree as two instances (RTP and RTPDP) with two tasks, VLER_EM_Real_Time_DBQ_Processor and VLER_EM_Real_Time_Outbound_Processor; the runbook notes both should be running. Logs E:\VLER\Logs\VES.OutboundProcessor, shared by both. Config preserved. Same releaseRoot path as VESEMSEGRESS01 on a different box.
